name: Kawakita (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Kawakita town emblem in white: a ring with a pointed bottom enclosing three vertical bars.
history: Municipal flag of Kawakita, a town in Ishikawa Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field.

features.role: Kawakita town emblem — a ring with a pointed bottom enclosing three vertical bars
